name: sgs/form-field-checkbox
title: SGS Checkbox Field
description: A checkbox group for multiple selections.

label.label: Group label
label._note: Renders as <legend class="sgs-form-field__label"> (not a plain <label> — this block groups multiple checkboxes under one <fieldset>). No per-instance colour/font-size/weight attribute exists; the legend is styled entirely by shared framework CSS shared with the other five form-field siblings. clusters: [] is a genuine gap, not hidden.

option.label: Each option (box and label)
option._note: Each entry in `options` renders as a repeated <label class="sgs-form-field__option"><input type="checkbox"><span> row. optionPresentation=card turns the row into a box (render.php prints a scoped rule on the field's uid class): background, border, radius, padding and gap on the row; boxSize, boxRadius and boxColourChecked on the custom tick box, which stays the real native input (appearance:none) with a visible focus ring. plain keeps the bare row.

help.label: Help text
help._note:
helpText itself is field-behaviour content, not a style property (Bean's non-cluster rule) — the rendered

also carries no per-instance style attribute of its own. clusters: []. The conformance checker's orphan scanner reports helpText as an ORPHAN here (its element-key-as-fallback-prefix convention coincidentally matches help+Text); this is a known false-positive of the checker, not evidence of an unaccounted style control — helpText is intentionally content, not style, and out of scope to silence without editing the checker script.

error.label: Error message
error._note: Populated by client-side validation JS, not a block attribute; the <span class="sgs-form-field__error"> has no per-instance style attribute. clusters: [].

optionRowMinHeight.description: Minimum height of the option row (the tap area). Empty keeps the stylesheet's 44px touch-target minimum.

optionPresentation.description: How each option row looks. plain = the stylesheet's bare row. card = a boxed row with its own background, border, padding and a custom tick box (the row settings below apply only to card).

rowBackground.description: Card row background: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = transparent.

rowBorderWidth.description: Card row border width as a box {top,right,bottom,left}, or one box per device. Empty = no border.

rowBorderStyle.description: Card row border style (solid, dashed, none...). Empty = solid.

rowBorderColour.description: Card row border colour: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = the text colour.

rowBorderRadius.description: Card row corner radius, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each {topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft}. Empty = square.

rowPadding.description: Card row padding, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Empty = the stylesheet's row padding.

rowGap.description: Space between the tick box and the label in a card row: a CSS length. Empty = the stylesheet's 0.5rem.

boxSize.description: Width and height of the card row's tick box: a CSS length. Empty = 24px.

boxRadius.description: Corner radius of the card row's tick box: a CSS length. Empty = 7px.

boxColourChecked.description: Fill of the tick box when ticked: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = the theme's primary colour.
